verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an in-app web playground, Forge at /app/playground, where you can upload a document and see results instantly before writing code, with no API key required. The changelog also shows Track Changes extraction previewable in the Playground. However, the docs do not explicitly show schema-based structured extraction (as distinct from parsing) running in the playground, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that structured extract results can be previewed in Forge, documentation of drag-and-drop upload, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I drag a document into a web playground and see parse/extract results before writing any code

citations.quote: Want to try before writing code? Upload a document to Forge to see results instantly — no API key required.
In-app playground renamed from “Forge Playground” to **Forge** (`/app/playground`).
Track Changes is now available in the Playground — upload a DOCX, PDF, or image file to preview tracked changes extraction results directly in the UI.
